protocol.backbone: frozen final direct CandidateChess v2; all original pretraining costs retained
protocol.loss: legal-move CE only; root value and backbone are unchanged
protocol.rewiring: five accepted swaps per original directed edge, capped at20 attempts per desired swap; preserve per-node in/out degrees separately per color; record unmet targets and retained edges
protocol.evaluation: all final heads finish before any evaluation; no selection, retries or budget extension
protocol.data_status: existing development data, never an untouched confirmation set
protocol.gate: Mean transport agreement gain on BOTH panels >=.01 over static/uniform/rewired, >=.005 over no_overlap, >=0 over unchanged backbone; every paired seed gain >=-.005 for each comparison
protocol.latency: first16 dev roots by frozen existing order; two warmups then3 repeats, all six methods rotated; full legal enumeration, encoding, graph construction including rewiring, frozen backbone and head inference, UCI choice
protocol.diagnostic: transport with rewired test-time edges, explicitly a corruption test not efficacy
protocol.bootstrap: 2000 source-game resamples per panel of paired correctness differences averaged over3 fitted seeds;95% percentile, descriptive and not simultaneous
protocol.training: 15 adapters; no new engine or external model calls
protocol.limits: Head controls store equal parameters; static/uniform disable router learning and no_overlap disables some input coordinates. Not matched active parameters or FLOPs. Frozen-backbone dependence; no Elo, calibration or novelty claim.

prior_preflight: runs/chess-transport-preflight-v1; artificial targets and runtime only
